## About
Collett Auto Care is a family owned and operated shop that has spent years serving the East Dallas area. Whether you need routine upkeep or a major repair, the team works on cars, trucks, SUVs and commercial vehicles.
The crew is happy to share what they know about taking care of your vehicle, from checking oil levels to keeping an engine from overheating. The goal is simple: take some of the stress out of car trouble.
Neighbors have given the shop a 4.5 rating from 330 Google reviews.

## Services
- Maintenance and diagnostics: Regular service and checks to catch problems early, before they turn into bigger repairs.
- Tire services: Tire installation, balancing, rotation and replacement.
- Wheel alignment: Alignment work for even tire wear, better handling and improved fuel efficiency.
- Brakes: Brake inspections covering pads, rotors, fluids and brake lines.
- Transmission: Maintenance, repair and replacement for automatic and manual transmissions.
- Suspension: Diagnostics and repairs when your ride starts to feel loose, noisy or shaky.
- Steering: Checks for alignment, worn components and leaks so the car steers the way it should.
- Air conditioning: AC recharge, diagnostics and repairs to keep you cool on Dallas roads.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Cars, trucks, SUVs and commercial vehicles.

Q: How do I schedule service?
A: Give the shop a call or send a message through the contact form, and the team will get back to you. You can also just visit during business hours.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Dallas and the surrounding areas.
